description: This file defines a CKEditor plugin dialog configuration for managing checkbox elements within the editor. It specifies dialog properties, event handlers, content setup and commit routines, and UI elements like text inputs and checkboxes.

methods.name: onShow
methods.description: Handles actions when the dialog is shown, such as retrieving the selected checkbox element and setting up content.

methods.name: onOk
methods.description: Handles actions when the OK button is pressed, creating a checkbox element if needed and committing content.

methods.name: setupContent
methods.description: Prepares the dialog content based on the selected element's data.

methods.name: commitContent
methods.description: Saves the data from dialog inputs back into the element being edited.
